name: hero_stats
description: Dota 2 hero meta: per-hero pick/win/ban counts in pro play, primary attribute, attack type, and roles. Optionally filter by role (e.g. "Carry", "Support"). OpenDota keyless data.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own OpenDota API key (free, from https://www.opendota.com/api-keys) for higher, PER-KEY rate limits. The endpoint is keyless: omit this and calls still work, but OpenDota rate-limits by calling IP and the shared Worker egress IP is frequently already at quota from unrelated traffic — a caller-supplied key escapes that.
